name: @apier-no/mcp
description: Apier MCP server: machine-verifiable Norwegian company authority for AI agents. Hardened thin proxy connecting local MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Zed) to Apier's hosted MCP server at https://www.apier.no/api/mcp: company verification and the register's coded signing rules (signaturrett and prokura) from Brønnøysundregistrene, with signed receipts. Try the API without signing up: the sandbox mirror under /api/v1/sandbox/ on apier.no accepts a self-invented apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> bearer and answers with fixtures (direct HTTP calls; starting the proxy itself requires APIER_API_KEY).
author: Grov Digital (org.nr. 833 397 982)
